description: This file implements Objective-C++ classes for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) convolution operations, including a data source class and a convolution operation class tailored for Apple's Metal framework on iOS/macOS. It defines methods for creating and managing convolution descriptors, data sources, and encoding convolution operations using Metal.

classes.name: MPSCNNConvDataSource
classes.description: Provides data (weights, biases, descriptor) for MPSCNN convolution operations, conforming to MPSCNNConvolutionDataSource protocol.

classes.name: MPSCNNConvOp
classes.description: Represents a Metal Performance Shaders convolution operation, including methods for creation and encoding to command buffers.

methods.name: initWithWeights:Bias:Desc:
methods.description: Initializes the data source with weights, bias, and descriptor.

methods.name: copyWithZone:
methods.description: Creates a copy of the data source.

methods.name: dataType
methods.description: Returns the data type used in the convolution (float32).

methods.name: load
methods.description: Indicates whether to load data; always returns true.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Releases references to weights and biases.

methods.name: conv2d:weights:bias:neuronFilter:
methods.description: Creates an MPSCNNConvOp instance configured with the given parameters, including handling depthwise or grouped convolution, setting stride, and neuron activation.

methods.name: encode:sourceImage:destinationImage:
methods.description: Encodes the convolution operation onto a Metal command buffer.
